No — the position is impaired; the risk is critical; the only defensible action is exit (attempt to unwind whatever liquidity appears) — or arguably reduce_to_target, but with 0 withdrawable, exit is the intent-level answer.

But the prompt says the keeper proposes an action and corridor limits enforce safety. In these risk-judge setups, the expected answer given confirmed bad debt and frozen funds is critical/exit. If Relend marks similarly, the user's $1,000 could lose ~87% of its value. That's critical.
